implementationDefinitions.LegacyCharacterized: Heuristic adapter source remains only behind the test-only legacy boundary.
implementationDefinitions.LimitedNative: A closed ZigCSS-native subset uses the rebuilt parser and public result ownership boundary.
implementationDefinitions.Removed: No adapter parser source or legacy Format tag remains; filename handling exists only to reject the unavailable input.

availabilityDefinitions.Unavailable: Rejected by the recovery CLI before output and absent from the public compile syntax enum.
availabilityDefinitions.ExperimentalLibrary: Available only through an explicit Zig library syntax tag; the recovery CLI and LSP still reject the extension.

compatibilityDefinitions.Unverified: Legacy characterization is not a compatibility contract or supported subset.
compatibilityDefinitions.NativeSubset: Only the exact published ZigCSS-native grammar and result contract are supported; this is not full ecosystem compatibility.

strategyDefinitions.limited-native-subset: Implement only a closed named grammar with strict errors outside it.
strategyDefinitions.remove-until-funded: Expose no adapter or ecosystem claim unless a later funded program accepts a new decision.

adapters.currentBoundary: No SCSS parser implementation remains; .scss is classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing byte preprocessing without a canonical lexer, evaluator, dependency model, and strict errors would recreate the removed corruption boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: No indented Sass parser implementation remains; .sass is classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing line/indent conversion without canonical Sass lexical, scope, module, interpolation, and expression behavior would recreate the removed guessing boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: No Less parser implementation remains; .less is classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing textual at-variable substitution without lexical scope, lazy evaluation, imports, strings/comments, arithmetic, dependencies, and strict errors would recreate the removed corruption boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: No Stylus parser implementation remains; .styl is classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing indentation conversion without a real grammar for optional punctuation, expressions, scope, dependencies, and strict errors would recreate the removed guessing boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: The Zig library scopes local-by-default classes, supports functional scope, plain-class composition, and token-aware local @value definitions, and returns owned class/value exports plus bounded module dependency facts. CLI and LSP exposure remain disabled.
knownRisks: Bare or structurally ambiguous scope switches, imported @value resolution, and raw module imports/exports remain strict errors under the chosen MODULE-002 scope.
Composition deliberately accepts only one plain local class target and returns unresolved external references rather than loading or flattening another module.
Local values replace identifier tokens in declaration values, supported at-rule preludes, and class aliases only; other selector positions are strict errors.
Untyped functional pseudos, selector-bearing or unknown at-rules, optimizer/prefix transforms, and native plugins remain outside the subset.

adapters.currentBoundary: No CSS-in-JS parser implementation remains; .css.js and .css.ts are classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing byte scanning without a version-pinned JavaScript/TypeScript parser, explicit tagged-template scope, non-executing static semantics, and strict dynamic-expression behavior would recreate the removed deletion boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: Fixed byte scanning for @apply plus deletion of selected at-rules before the inherited CSS parser; there is no JavaScript plugin host.
knownRisks: @custom-media and @nest constructs are skipped without a diagnostic or semantic expansion.
No plugin discovery, configuration, ordering, lifecycle, dependency, or source-map contract exists.

adapters.currentBoundary: A fixed in-memory utility table expands whitespace-separated names only when encountered by the PostCSS-like @apply scanner.
knownRisks: Unknown utilities are silently omitted from the expansion.
Content scanning, configuration, versions, variants, plugins, arbitrary values, ordering, and canonical Tailwind semantics are absent.
